descriptionByLocale.en:
## Main responsibilities

- Global Business & Functional Analysis:

- Lead the collection and documentation of global requirements for system and process changes across Compliance & Legal functions.

- Assists in identifying, evaluating and business specification development for systems and procedures that are cost effective and meet requirements.

- Serve as a key interface between global and local teams, ensuring alignment across business units and jurisdictions

- Map end-to-end processes and highlight regional variations for harmonization

- Systems Oversight & Operational Support:

- Serve as a key interface between the Legal & Compliance and COO Functions and coordinate enhancements, upgrades, and issue resolution across SAS AML, GT Exchange, FircoContinuity, and Pythagoras

- Support global change initiatives, including tool implementation, data quality initiatives, and regulatory adaptations

- Support UAT processes, system documentation, and global roll-out coordination

- Governance:

- Contribute to governance forums by preparing consistent, global-level reporting and status updates

## Skills and experience

- Solid understanding of compliance environments and internal control frameworks in banking or financial services.

- Strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder management capabilities

- Autonomy, reliability, and high ownership mindset; able to deliver in fast-paced and high-responsibility contexts.

- Global mindset with excellent cross-cultural communication skills.

- Fluency in English

- Experience with project governance tools and data visualisation (e.g. JIRA, SharePoint, Power BI, Excel dashboards).

- Technically fluent in compliance tool functionality, system workflows, and data flows

- University degree in Law, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.

- 5+ years of experience in the Banking Industry in Compliance, Risk, Audit, or Transformation roles, ideally within banking groups or international financial institutions

## Our values

-  Accountability : Taking ownership for tasks and challenges as well as seeking continuous improvement

-  Hands-on : Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

-  Passionate : Being committed and striving for excellence

-  Solution-driven : Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

-  Partnership-oriented : Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

Job Description

The Strategic Planning Officer will be part of the Strategy & Corporate Development Team in Lugano and will contribute to run an integrated planning, reporting and performance review process to facilitate value-driven business decision-making. In his role as a business partner and challenger of business performance he will focus on value-added decision support through granular analysis of performance root causes and by providing insights on value creation levers.

The Strategic Planning Officer will play an active role in the business performance dialogues, support business development and provide value-added decision support using data modelling and forecasting intelligence.

Main responsibilities
- Business analyst and power user of MI data
- Establish and compile presentations to senior management
- Take active role in the business performance dialogues
- Design and maintain data models for analysis and forecasting
- Active collaboration with Planning & Controlling unit during budgeting and forecasting process
- Develop strong relationship with business management and business controllers to build a role as business partner
- Develop recurring benchmarking analysis in collaboration with external advisors

-
Key collaboration in corporate development projects and strategic initiatives, including M&A transactions

Skills and experience
- Have professional experience in Financial Services Industry, in particular in Corporate Finance activities
- Ability to understand large datasets and experience of data modelling, providing accurate data analysis
- Power user of MS-Excel and MS-PowerPoint; Knowledge of using Excel Macros, VBA, Python, Power BI as a plus
- Quick learner, accurate and efficient
- Proactive attitude and willingness to take on new knowledge and skills
- Ability to work under pressure and adapt to unforeseen work demands
- Good communication skills to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders at all levels

-
Fluent in English and fluent in Italian

Our Values
- Accountability : Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement
- Hands-on : Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results
- Passionate : Being committed and striving for excellence
- Solution-driven : Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset
- Partnership-oriented : Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

La nostra azienda EFG International è un gruppo globale di private banking, che offre servizi di private banking e gestione patrimoniale. Serviamo clienti in oltre 40 sedi in tutto il mondo. EFG International offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e dinamico e si impegna a essere un datore di lavoro di scelta. La nostra missione e il nostro scopo Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future. Descrizione del lavoro L'Ufficiale di Pianificazione Strategica farà parte del Team di Strategia e Sviluppo Aziendale a Lugano e contribuirà a gestire un processo integrato di pianificazione, reporting e revisione delle prestazioni per facilitare decisioni aziendali guidate dal valore. Nel suo ruolo di partner aziendale e sfidante delle prestazioni aziendali, si concentrerà sul supporto decisionale a valore aggiunto attraverso un'analisi granulare delle cause profonde delle prestazioni e fornendo informazioni approfondite sui fattori di creazione di valore. L'Ufficiale di Pianificazione Strategica svolgerà un ruolo attivo nei dialoghi sulle prestazioni aziendali, supporterà lo sviluppo aziendale e fornirà supporto decisionale a valore aggiunto utilizzando la modellazione dei dati e l'intelligence previsionale. - Creare e compilare presentazioni per la direzione
- Partecipare attivamente ai dialoghi sulle prestazioni aziendali
- Progettare e mantenere modelli di dati per l'analisi e la previsione

- Sviluppare una forte relazione con la gestione aziendale e i responsabili dei controlli per costruire un ruolo di partner aziendale
- Sviluppare analisi di benchmarking ricorrenti in collaborazione con consulenti esterni
- Collaborazione chiave in progetti di sviluppo aziendale e iniziative strategiche, comprese transazioni M&A Requisiti
- Avere esperienza professionale nel settore dei servizi finanziari, in particolare nelle attività di Corporate Finance
- Capacità di comprendere grandi dataset e esperienza di modellazione dei dati, fornendo analisi accurate dei dati
- Utente avanzato di MS-Excel e MS-PowerPoint; Conoscenza dell'uso di Excel Macros, VBA, Python, Power BI come plus
- Velocità di apprendimento, accuratezza ed efficienza
- Atteggiamento proattivo e disponibilità a prendere nuove conoscenze e competenze
- Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e adattarsi a richieste di lavoro impreviste
- Buone capacità di comunicazione per comunicare efficacemente con gli stakeholder interni a tutti i livelli
- Fluente in inglese e fluente in italiano I nostri valori

- Jouer un rôle clé dans le renforcement des capacités de l'équipe en matière d'extraction de données et agir en tant qu'expert en données, en fournissant des conseils sur le traitement et l'analyse des données
- Se tenir au courant des principaux développements et tendances techniques (par exemple l'IA, les technologies du cloud) et évaluer leur pertinence pour le paysage de données et d'analyses du Groupe

Compétences et expérience
- Diplôme universitaire en commerce, informatique, informatique ou ingénierie
- Niveau avancé dans les outils de visualisation des données tels que Power Query, Power BI, Tableau ou similaire
- Connaissance avancée de SQL et Python pour la recherche de bases de données et l'extraction de données
- Un état d'esprit analytique et structuré avec de solides compétences en communication
- Aptitude pratique, pratique et résolution de problèmes
- Un état d'esprit orienté vers l'avenir et une approche proactive des développements techniques et des tendances dans un environnement dynamique
Nos valeurs

Responsabilité : Prise en charge des tâches et des défis, et recherche d'amélioration continue

Hands-on : Être proactif pour obtenir rapidement des résultats de haute qualité

Passionné : Être engagé et chercher l'excellence

Solution : Se concentrer sur les résultats des clients et traiter les clients équitablement avec un état d'esprit conscient des risques

Partenariat : Promouvoir la collaboration et le travail d'équipe. Travailler ensemble avec un esprit d'entreprise.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The role operates as a career-competent regulatory reporting analyst within the CFO function, with a solid understanding of prudential regulation and reporting processes, and primary accountability for the accurate and timely completion of assigned Swiss and international regulatory returns (e.g. Capital Adequacy, LCR, NSFR, statistical reports).

The role works independently across the full reporting cycle for its scope, seeking guidance from more senior colleagues on complex or ambiguous issues, and adapts existing methods to non-standard situations to maintain data quality and compliance. It interacts frequently with colleagues in Accounting, Risk, Treasury, Front Office, IT and upstream data providers to clarify requirements, resolve data issues and explain regulatory impacts on their activities, enhancing relationships and building trust. The role contributes to short- to medium-term departmental objectives by implementing process improvements, supporting change initiatives and leading smaller projects or sub-workstreams that improve the sustainability and audit-readiness of regulatory reporting. The role does not hold formal budget ownership but supports resource planning and prioritisation for its projects and deliverables.

Main duties & responsibilities

Regulatory Production & Ownership
- Develops and delivers the end-to-end production of assigned Swiss and international regulatory returns (e.g. Capital Adequacy, LCR, NSFR, statistical reports), ensuring complete and accurate submissions within regulatory deadlines.
- Implements and maintains the operational schedule for own reporting scope, identifying required inputs and coordinating with relevant stakeholders to meet concurrent monthly and quarterly deadlines.
- Ensures that processes and documentation for assigned reports remain sustainable and audit-ready, and identifies opportunities to streamline steps in line with the department’s medium-term automation and operational excellence goals.

Regulatory Interpretation & Complex Analysis
- Analyses complex financial structures (e.g. derivatives, structured products) within own reporting perimeter to determine the correct regulatory treatment, and escalates particularly ambiguous cases to more senior specialists where needed.
- Develops and applies robust proxy logic or manual workarounds for data gaps in defined areas, balancing regulatory expectations and operational constraints, and documents these approaches for review and approval.
- Evaluates variances and trends in capital and liquidity metrics for assigned reports, and prepares clear explanations of the drivers behind fluctuations for senior stakeholders in Risk, Treasury and CFO management.

Change Management & Implementation
- Monitors upcoming regulatory changes (e.g. FINMA ordinances, EBA guidelines) relevant to own reporting scope, and evaluates their impact on data, systems and processes, providing input into adaptation plans.
- Implements smaller regulatory or IT changes within the reporting area, or leads sub-workstreams in larger automation projects, by defining business requirements for tools such as Mercury and OneSumX and supporting testing activities.
- Negotiates with IT and upstream data providers on specific data requirements and timelines for own deliverables, ensuring that regulatory needs are understood and appropriately prioritised.

Advisory & Collaboration
- Advises colleagues in Accounting, Risk, Front Office and other functions on the regulatory implications of their activities within the scope of assigned reports, and persuades them to adopt necessary data quality and booking standards.
- Provides technical guidance and support to junior analysts in the Regulatory Reporting team on defined topics, reviewing their work for accuracy and helping them navigate complex reporting scenarios.
- Builds and maintains effective working relationships with senior internal colleagues across the CFO function and with external vendors where relevant, adapting communication style to different audiences.

Employee Profile

Professional Skills

Education (minimum / preferred)
- Minimum: University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent professional experience in financial services.
- Preferred: Postgraduate qualification and/or professional certification in Accounting, Risk, or Regulatory Reporting is an advantage.

Professional experience
- Typically 6–10 years of experience in private banking or financial services in Regulatory Reporting, Financial Accounting, Risk or Audit, with significant exposure to prudential regulation.
- Demonstrated experience working independently on regulatory reporting deliverables, with guidance from more senior colleagues on complex issues.

Technical knowledge
- Advanced understanding of the regulatory landscape and tools relevant to the role (e.g. Basel III, FINMA Circulars, Mercury, OneSumX) and of how these requirements translate into data and reporting processes.
- Broad knowledge of related departments (Risk, Treasury, Accounting, Private Banking) and their interrelationships, with the ability to use this understanding to provide appropriate solutions to problems.
- High proficiency in MS Excel and Mercury; practical experience with SQL; knowledge of VBA or data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI) is a plus.

Languages
- English: Full professional proficiency (spoken and written).
- French: Fluency is a significant asset for interaction with local stakeholders in Geneva.
descriptionByLocale.it:
Il ruolo opera come analista di reportistica regolamentare competente per la carriera all'interno della funzione CFO, con una solida comprensione dei processi di regolamentazione e reportistica prudenziale, e la responsabilità primaria per il completamento accurato e tempestivo dei ritorni normativi svizzeri e internazionali assegnati (ad esempio Capital Adequacy, LCR, NSFR, report statistici).

Il ruolo funziona indipendentemente attraverso il ciclo di report completo per il suo ambito, alla ricerca di indicazioni da colleghi più anziani su questioni complesse o ambigue, e adatta i metodi esistenti a situazioni non standard per mantenere la qualità e la conformità dei dati. Interagisce frequentemente con colleghi in Contabilità, Rischio, Tesoro, Front Office, IT e fornitori di dati a monte per chiarire i requisiti, risolvere i problemi dei dati e spiegare gli impatti normativi sulle loro attività, migliorare le relazioni e costruire la fiducia. Il ruolo contribuisce agli obiettivi dipartimentali a breve e medio termine implementando i miglioramenti dei processi, supportando iniziative di cambiamento e conducendo progetti più piccoli o sotto-lavoro che migliorano la sostenibilità e la prontezza di revisione delle normative. Il ruolo non ha la proprietà formale del bilancio, ma supporta la pianificazione delle risorse e la priorità per i suoi progetti e realizzabili.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

Produzione e proprietà regolamentari
- Sviluppa e fornisce la produzione end-to-end dei rendimenti normativi svizzeri e internazionali assegnati (ad esempio Capital Adequacy, LCR, NSFR, report statistici), assicurando presentazioni complete e accurate entro le scadenze regolamentari.
- Implementa e mantiene il programma operativo per il proprio ambito di reporting, identificando gli input richiesti e coordinando con le parti interessate pertinenti per soddisfare le scadenze mensili e trimestrali.
- Assicura che i processi e la documentazione per i report assegnati rimangano sostenibili e pronti all’audit, e identifica le opportunità di semplificare i passi in linea con gli obiettivi di automazione a medio termine e di eccellenza operativa del dipartimento.

Interpretazione regolamentare e analisi complessa
- Analizza strutture finanziarie complesse (ad esempio derivati, prodotti strutturati) all'interno del proprio perimetro di segnalazione per determinare il corretto trattamento normativo, ed escala casi particolarmente ambigui a specialisti più anziani dove necessario.
- Sviluppa e applica una logica di proxy robusta o soluzioni manuali per le lacune dei dati in aree definite, bilanciando le aspettative normative e i vincoli operativi, e documenta questi approcci per la revisione e l'approvazione.
- Valuta le variazioni e le tendenze nelle metriche di capitale e liquidità per i report assegnati, e prepara chiare spiegazioni dei driver dietro fluttuazioni per gli stakeholder senior nella gestione del rischio, del Tesoro e del CFO.

Gestione del cambiamento e attuazione
- Monitora i prossimi cambiamenti normativi (ad esempio le ordinanze FINMA, le linee guida EBA) rilevanti per il proprio ambito di reportistica e valuta il loro impatto sui dati, sistemi e processi, fornendo input ai piani di adattamento.

- implementa piccoli cambiamenti normativi o IT all'interno dell'area di reporting, o conduce sotto-lavoro in progetti di automazione più grandi, definendo i requisiti aziendali per strumenti come Mercury e OneSumX e supportando le attività di test.
- Negozia con i fornitori di dati IT e a monte su specifiche esigenze di dati e tempi per i propri fornitori, assicurando che le esigenze di regolamentazione siano comprese e opportunamente priorità.

Consulenza e collaborazione
- Consulta i colleghi in Contabilità, Rischio, Front Office e altre funzioni sulle implicazioni normative delle loro attività nell'ambito delle relazioni assegnate, e li persuade ad adottare le necessarie qualità dei dati e standard di prenotazione.
- Fornisce assistenza tecnica e supporto agli analisti junior nel team di reporting regolamentare su argomenti definiti, rivedendo il loro lavoro per l'accuratezza e aiutandoli a navigare scenari di report complessi.
- Costruisce e mantiene relazioni di lavoro efficaci con colleghi interni senior in tutta la funzione CFO e con fornitori esterni dove pertinente, adattando lo stile di comunicazione a diversi pubblico.

Profilo dei dipendenti

Abilità professionali

Istruzione (minimo / preferito)
- Minimo: laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, Economia, Business Administration o una disciplina quantitativa correlata, o equivalente esperienza professionale nei servizi finanziari.
- Preferito: qualifica post-laurea e/o certificazione professionale in Contabilità, Rischio, o Resoconto Regolamentare è un vantaggio.

Esperienza professionale
- Tipicamente 6-10 anni di esperienza nei servizi bancari privati o finanziari nel reporting regolamentare, contabilizzazione finanziaria, rischio o controllo, con esposizione significativa alla regolamentazione prudenziale.
- Esperienza dimostrata che lavora in modo indipendente sui responsabili delle relazioni normative, con la guida di colleghi più anziani su questioni complesse.

Conoscenza tecnica
- Comprensione avanzata del panorama normativo e degli strumenti rilevanti per il ruolo (ad esempio Basilea III, FINMA Circulars, Mercury, OneSumX) e di come questi requisiti si traducono in processi di data e reporting.
- Ampia conoscenza dei servizi correlati (Rischio, Tesoro, Contabilità, Private Banking) e delle loro interrelazioni, con la capacità di utilizzare questa comprensione per fornire soluzioni adeguate ai problemi.
- Alta competenza in MS Excel e Mercury; esperienza pratica con SQL; conoscenza di VBA o strumenti di visualizzazione dati (ad esempio Power BI) è un plus.

Lingue
- Inglese: piena competenza professionale (spoken e scritto).
- Francese: Fluency è un bene significativo per l'interazione con gli stakeholder locali a Ginevra.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Rolle fungiert als Karriere-Kompetenz-Reporting-Analyst innerhalb der CFO-Funktion, mit einem soliden Verständnis von Aufsichts- und Berichterstattungsprozessen, und primäre Rechenschaftspflicht für die genaue und rechtzeitige Fertigstellung von zugewiesenen Schweizer und internationalen regulatorischen Renditen (z.B. Capital Adequacy, LCR, NSFR, statistische Berichte).

Die Rolle funktioniert unabhängig über den gesamten Berichtszyklus für ihren Umfang, sucht Beratung von höheren Kollegen zu komplexen oder mehrdeutigen Fragen und passt bestehende Methoden an nicht standardisierte Situationen, um Datenqualität und Compliance zu erhalten. Es interagiert häufig mit Kollegen in Accounting, Risk, Treasury, Front Office, IT und vorgelagerten Datenanbietern, um Anforderungen zu klären, Datenprobleme zu lösen und regulatorische Auswirkungen auf ihre Aktivitäten zu erklären, Beziehungen zu verbessern und Vertrauen aufzubauen. Die Rolle trägt zu kurz- bis mittelfristigen abteilungsbezogenen Zielen bei, indem Prozessverbesserungen umgesetzt werden, Änderungsinitiativen unterstützt und kleinere Projekte oder Teilprojekte gefördert werden, die die Nachhaltigkeit und die Auditbereitschaft der regulatorischen Berichterstattung verbessern. Die Rolle hält nicht formale Budgetbesitze, sondern unterstützt die Ressourcenplanung und Priorisierung für ihre Projekte und Lieferungen.

Hauptpflichten & Verantwortlichkeiten

Regulatorische Produktion & Eigentum
- Entwickelt und liefert die End-to-End-Produktion von zugewiesenen schweizerischen und internationalen regulatorischen Renditen (z.B. Capital Adequacy, LCR, NSFR, statistische Berichte), um vollständige und genaue Einreichungen innerhalb regulatorischer Fristen sicherzustellen.
- Ergänzt und pflegt den operativen Zeitplan für den eigenen Berichtsumfang, die Identifizierung der erforderlichen Inputs und die Koordinierung mit den relevanten Akteuren, um gleichzeitige monatliche und vierteljährliche Fristen zu erfüllen.
- Stellen Sie sicher, dass Prozesse und Dokumentationen für zugeordnete Berichte nachhaltig und auditbereit bleiben und Möglichkeiten zur Optimierung von Schritten im Einklang mit den mittelfristigen Automatisierungs- und operativen Exzellenzzielen der Abteilung erkennen.

Regulatorische Interpretation und komplexe Analyse
- Analysiert komplexe Finanzstrukturen (z.B. Derivate, strukturierte Produkte) innerhalb eines eigenen Meldeumfangs, um die korrekte Regulierungsbehandlung zu bestimmen, und eskaliert besonders eindeutige Fälle für ältere Spezialisten, wenn nötig.
- Entwickelt und wendet robuste Proxylogik oder manuelle Workarounds für Datenlücken in definierten Bereichen an, bilanziert regulatorische Erwartungen und betriebliche Zwänge und dokumentiert diese Ansätze für Überprüfung und Zulassung.
- Bewertet Varianzen und Trends in Kapital- und Liquiditätsmetriken für zugeordnete Berichte und bereitet klare Erklärungen der Fahrer hinter Schwankungen für Senior Stakeholder im Risiko-, Schatz- und CFO-Management vor.

Change Management und Implementierung
- Überwacht anstehende regulatorische Veränderungen (z.B. FINMA-Verordnungen, EBA-Richtlinien), die für den eigenen Berichtsbereich relevant sind, und wertet ihre Auswirkungen auf Daten, Systeme und Prozesse aus und bietet Input in Anpassungspläne.
- Ergänzt kleinere regulatorische oder IT-Änderungen innerhalb des Berichtsbereichs oder führt Teil-Workstreams in größeren Automatisierungsprojekten durch die Festlegung von Geschäftsanforderungen an Werkzeuge wie Mercury und OneSumX und die Unterstützung von Testaktivitäten.
- Verhandelt mit IT und vorgelagerten Datenanbietern über spezifische Datenanforderungen und Zeitpläne für eigene Lieferungen, um sicherzustellen, dass regulatorische Anforderungen verstanden und entsprechend priorisiert werden.

Beratung & Zusammenarbeit
- Beratung von Kollegen in Accounting, Risk, Front Office und anderen Funktionen über die regulatorischen Auswirkungen ihrer Aktivitäten im Rahmen von zugewiesenen Berichten und überzeugt sie, notwendige Datenqualität und Buchungsstandards zu übernehmen.
- Bietet technische Beratung und Unterstützung für Nachwuchsanalysten im Regulatory Reporting Team zu definierten Themen, ihre Arbeit zur Genauigkeit zu überprüfen und ihnen dabei zu helfen, komplexe Reportingszenarien zu navigieren.
- Erstellt und pflegt effektive Arbeitsbeziehungen mit älteren internen Kollegen über die CFO-Funktion und mit externen Anbietern, soweit relevant, Anpassung des Kommunikationsstils an verschiedene Publikum.

Mitarbeiterprofil

Professionelle Fähigkeiten

Ausbildung (Mindest / Vorzug)
- Minimum: Hochschulabschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer damit verbundenen quantitativen Disziplin oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung in Finanzdienstleistungen.
- Bevorzugt: Postgraduate-Qualifikation und/oder professionelle Zertifizierung in Accounting, Risk oder Regulatory Reporting ist ein Vorteil.

Berufserfahrung
- Typischerweise 6–10 Jahre Erfahrung in Privatbanken oder Finanzdienstleistungen im Regulatory Reporting, Financial Accounting, Risk oder Audit mit signifikanter Exposition gegenüber Aufsichtsbehörden.
- Demonstrierte Erfahrung, die unabhängig an regulatorischen Reporting-Lieferanten arbeitet, mit Anleitung von höheren Kollegen zu komplexen Fragen.

Technische Kenntnisse
- Fortgeschrittenes Verständnis der für die Rolle relevanten regulatorischen Landschaft und Werkzeuge (z.B. Basel III, FINMA-Circulars, Mercury, OneSumX) und wie diese Anforderungen in Daten- und Berichtsprozesse übergehen.

- breites Wissen über verwandte Abteilungen (Risk, Schatzkammer, Buchhaltung, Private Banking) und ihre Beziehungen, mit der Fähigkeit, dieses Verständnis zu nutzen, um geeignete Lösungen für Probleme zu bieten.
- Hohe Kompetenz in MS Excel und Merkur; praktische Erfahrung mit SQL; Wissen über VBA oder Datenvisualisierungstools (z.B. Power BI) ist ein Plus.

Sprachen
- Englisch: Full professional proficiency (spoken und geschrieben).
- Französisch: Fluency ist ein bedeutender Vorteil für die Interaktion mit lokalen Akteuren in Genf.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ce rôle joue le rôle d'analyste de la réglementation compétent en matière de carrière au sein de la fonction DPF, avec une bonne compréhension de la réglementation prudentielle et des processus de déclaration, et la responsabilité principale de l'achèvement exact et en temps opportun des rapports réglementaires suisses et internationaux attribués (p. ex., Capital Adequacy, LCR, NSFR, rapports statistiques). Ce rôle fonctionne de façon indépendante tout au long du cycle complet de présentation des rapports, en cherchant des conseils à des collègues de haut niveau sur des questions complexes ou ambiguës, et en adaptant les méthodes existantes à des situations atypiques pour maintenir la qualité et la conformité des données. Il interagit fréquemment avec ses collègues de la comptabilité, du risque, du Trésor, de l'administration centrale, de la TI et des fournisseurs de données en amont pour clarifier les exigences, résoudre les problèmes de données et expliquer les répercussions de la réglementation sur leurs activités, améliorer les relations et instaurer la confiance. Le rôle contribue à la réalisation des objectifs ministériels à court et à moyen terme en mettant en oeuvre des améliorations des processus, en appuyant les initiatives de changement et en dirigeant des projets ou sous-programmes de moindre envergure qui améliorent la viabilité et la préparation à la vérification des rapports réglementaires. Le rôle n'est pas la propriété officielle du budget, mais il soutient la planification des ressources et l'établissement de priorités pour ses projets et produits livrables. Principales fonctions et responsabilités Réglementation Production et propriété
- Élaborer et produire de bout en bout des rapports réglementaires suisses et internationaux (p. ex. Capital Adequacy, LCR, NSFR, rapports statistiques), en veillant à ce que les présentations soient complètes et exactes dans les délais réglementaires.
- Mettre en œuvre et tenir à jour le calendrier opérationnel pour sa propre portée de rapport, identifier les apports requis et coordonner avec les parties prenantes concernées pour respecter les échéances mensuelles et trimestrielles simultanées.
- S'assure que les processus et la documentation pour les rapports attribués demeurent durables et prêts à l'audit et identifie les possibilités de rationaliser les étapes conformément aux objectifs du Ministère en matière d'automatisation à moyen terme et d'excellence opérationnelle. Interprétation de la réglementation et analyse complexe
- Analyse les structures financières complexes (p. ex., les produits dérivés, les produits structurés) à l'intérieur de son propre périmètre de déclaration afin de déterminer le traitement réglementaire correct, et augmente les cas particulièrement ambigus à des spécialistes plus expérimentés au besoin.
- Concevoir et appliquer une logique de remplacement solide ou des solutions de rechange manuelles pour combler les lacunes de données dans des domaines définis, équilibrer les attentes réglementaires et les contraintes opérationnelles, et documenter ces approches pour examen et approbation.
- Évaluer les écarts et les tendances des mesures du capital et de la liquidité pour les rapports attribués, et préparer des explications claires sur les facteurs à l'origine des fluctuations pour les principaux intervenants en gestion des risques, de la trésorerie et des DPF. Gestion et mise en oeuvre du changement
- Surveiller les changements réglementaires à venir (p. ex. ordonnances FINMA, lignes directrices de l'ABE) qui se rapportent à sa propre portée de déclaration, et évaluer leur impact sur les données, les systèmes et les processus, en fournissant des contributions aux plans d'adaptation.
- Mettre en oeuvre des changements réglementaires ou informatiques plus petits dans la zone de déclaration, ou diriger des sous-groupes de travail dans des projets d'automatisation plus importants, en définissant les exigences opérationnelles pour des outils tels que Mercure et OneSumX et en appuyant les activités d'essai.
- Négocier avec les fournisseurs de données informatiques et en amont des exigences spécifiques en matière de données et des délais pour les produits livrables, en veillant à ce que les besoins réglementaires soient compris et hiérarchisés de manière appropriée. Conseils et collaboration
- Conseiller ses collègues en comptabilité, risque, service de liaison et autres fonctions sur les implications réglementaires de leurs activités dans le cadre des rapports attribués, et les persuader d'adopter les normes de qualité des données et de réservation nécessaires.
- Fournit une orientation technique et un soutien aux analystes subalternes de l'équipe des rapports réglementaires sur des sujets précis, examine leur travail pour en déterminer l'exactitude et les aider à naviguer dans des scénarios de rapports complexes.
- Établir et entretenir des relations de travail efficaces avec des collègues internes supérieurs dans l'ensemble de la fonction DPF et avec des fournisseurs externes, le cas échéant, en adaptant le style de communication à différents publics. Profil de l'employé Formation professionnelle (minimum / préféré)
- Minimum: Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, économie, administration des affaires ou une discipline quantitative connexe, ou une expérience professionnelle équivalente dans les services financiers.
- Préféré : La qualification postdoctorale et/ou la certification professionnelle en comptabilité, en risques ou en rapports réglementaires est un avantage. Expérience professionnelle
- De 6 à 10 ans d'expérience en banque privée ou en services financiers dans les domaines de la déclaration réglementaire, de la comptabilité financière, du risque ou de la vérification, avec une exposition importante à la réglementation prudentielle.
- Expérience démontrée en travaillant de façon indépendante sur les produits livrables des rapports réglementaires, avec des conseils de collègues plus expérimentés sur des questions complexes. Connaissances techniques
- Connaissance approfondie du paysage réglementaire et des outils pertinents au rôle (par exemple Bâle III, Circulaires FINMA, Mercure, OneSumX) et de la façon dont ces exigences se traduisent en données et en processus de déclaration.
- Une vaste connaissance des services connexes (risque, Trésorerie, Comptabilité, Banque privée) et de leurs relations, avec la capacité d'utiliser cette compréhension pour apporter des solutions appropriées aux problèmes.
- Haute compétence en MS Excel et Mercury ; expérience pratique avec SQL ; connaissance des outils de visualisation VBA ou de données (par exemple Power BI) est un plus. Langues
- Anglais : Compétence professionnelle complète (parlé et écrit).
- Français : La fluidité est un atout important pour l'interaction avec les acteurs locaux à Genève.

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire principal de la transformation stratégique

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Main responsibilities

Enterprise & Strategic Transformation

- Drive bank-wide transformation initiatives aligned with the long-term strategy of EFG

- Translate strategic priorities (growth, efficiency, client experience) into concrete transformation roadmaps.

- Support Executive Committee members in strategy execution and transformation governance.

- Prepare decision material for senior management and Board-level discussions

Operating Model & Process Excellence

- Design and implement target operating models adapted to a relationship-driven private banking environment.

- Support optimization of front-to-back processes across:
-  Client Relationship Management and Client Advisory

-  Investment Services and Portfolio Management

-  Operations and Middle Office

- Lead cost-efficiency and productivity initiatives while preserving service quality and client experience

Digital & Data Transformation

- Lead business-driven digital initiatives including:
-  CRM and client lifecycle management

-  Advisory and portfolio management tools

-  Process automation (workflow digitization, RPA, AI use cases)

- Act as bridge between business, IT, and data teams to ensure adoption and value realization.

- Promote data-driven management through dashboards, KPIs, and management information.

Regulatory & Risk-Driven Change

- Manage transformation initiatives related to FINMA regulation, AML/KYC, suitability, cross-border rules.

- Ensure regulatory changes are embedded pragmatically into business processes.

- Work closely with Compliance, Risk, Legal, and Internal Audit.

Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement

- Act as an internal change leader and sparring partner for senior executives and department heads.

- Drive change management: communication, training, and adoption across the organization.

- Manage resistance to change in a traditional private banking culture.

Program & Delivery Management

- Own end-to-end delivery of transformation initiatives:
-  Governance, milestones, KPIs, and benefits realization

-  Budget and resource management

-  Risk, dependency, and issue management

- Coordinate internal teams and selectively manage external consultants and vendors.

## Skills and experience

- Pure Private Banking Expertise, with hands-on understanding of:
- Relationship-based private banking business model

- Investment products and services

- UHNW/HNW client expectations

- Strong sensitivity to confidentiality, risk culture, and reputational consideration

- Transformation & Execution
- Enterprise and functional transformation

- Operating model design

- Business case development and benefits tracking

- Program and portfolio management

- Digital & Analytical Skills
- Ability to translate technology into business value

- CRM platforms, Front office / Investment applications and private banking core systems

- Process automation and digitalisation / AI in banking

- Data analytics and performance management

- Leadership & Personal Skills
- Executive-level communication and presentation skills

- Strong influencing skills without formal authority

- Structured problem-solving and analytical rigor

- High discretion, resilience, and ownership mindset

- Strong cultural fit with Swiss private banking values

- Experience & Background
- Background / profile : Chief of Staff, Internal transformation, COO Office, or strategy roles within private banks and/or top-tier strategy/management consulting

- 10–15 years of professional experience

- Proven track record delivering in-house transformation initiatives

- Strong exposure to Swiss private banking market and regulatory environment

- International experience considered an asset

- Education
- MBA from a leading business school

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Job Description

The Talent Acquisition (TA) team is part of the Human Resources function and is responsible for attracting and hiring the best talent in the market for EFG Bank.

We are looking for a motivated Talent Acquisition Intern to join our team for a 6‑month internship in Lugano or Geneva. In this role, you will play a key part in enhancing the candidate experience, supporting Talent Acquisition in day‑to‑day activities, and contributing to reporting and process optimisation. You will also have the opportunity to support, and progressively manage, some junior recruitment mandates under guidance.

Key Responsibilities

Candidate Experience & TA Support

- Act as a point of contact for candidates, ensuring clear, timely and professional communication throughout the recruitment process.

- Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and other stakeholders.

- Support Talent Acquisition Specialists in screening CVs and assessing candidates against role requirements.

- Draft and post job advertisements on internal and external platforms, ensuring consistency with EFG’s employer brand.
  Operational & Administrative Support

- Execute daily operations in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), including data entry, data quality checks and status updates.

- Maintain accurate candidate records and ensure proper documentation of each recruitment step.

- Prepare standard correspondence and communication to candidates and hiring managers.

- Support coordination of assessments (tests, case studies, reference checks), where applicable.
  Reporting & Process Improvement

- Support the preparation of regular recruitment reports and simple dashboards (e.g. pipeline status, time‑to‑hire, sources of hire).

- Help monitor key TA metrics and identify basic trends or bottlenecks in the process.

- Contribute ideas to streamline and standardise recruitment processes, templates and communication flows.

- Participate in small projects aimed at improving tools, candidate experience and internal TA efficiency.
  Sourcing & Employer Branding Support

- Assist in sourcing candidates via LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals and other channels.

- Conduct initial phone or video pre‑screenings for selected roles, under supervision.

- Support employer branding initiatives (e.g. content preparation for social media or the career site, or job fairs).
  Exposure to Junior Recruitment

- Progressively support and, where appropriate, manage end‑to‑end recruitment for selected junior or intern positions, under the guidance of a Talent Acquisition Specialist.

## Skills and experience

Education & Experience

- Master’s degree (or currently enrolled in a Master’s program) in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field.

- Previous experience (internship, part time role or similar) in recruiting, HR or employer branding is a plus.

- Experience in data management, reporting or working with HR/ATS systems is an advantage.
  Language Skills

- Excellent command of English (spoken and written).

- Good command of Italian or French is considered a strong plus, depending on the location.
  Technical & Analytical Skills

- Interest in working with HR tools and platforms (e.g. Applicant Tracking Systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, career websites).

- Good MS Office skills, especially in Excel and PowerPoint, with an interest in reporting and basic analytics.

- High attention to detail and accuracy in handling data and administrative tasks.
  Personal Competencies

- Strong interest in Talent Acquisition, the banking industry and investment management.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a natural focus on service and candidate experience.

- Organised, structured and able to manage multiple tasks and priorities.

- Proactive, curious and willing to take ownership of tasks and suggest improvements.

- Team oriented, collaborative and comfortable working in an international and multicultural environment.

- Alignment with EFG’s entrepreneurial culture: hands on, solutions oriented and open to learning.

## Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

## Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

- Contribuire con idee per ottimizzare e standardizzare i processi di reclutamento, i modelli e i flussi di comunicazione.

## Competenze e esperienza Istruzione & Esperienza
- Laurea magistrale (o attualmente iscritto a un programma di laurea magistrale) in Risorse Umane, Amministrazione Aziendale, Psicologia o un campo correlato.
- Esperienza precedente (stage, ruolo part-time o simile) nel recruiting, HR o employer branding è un plus.
- Esperienza in gestione dei dati, reporting o lavoro con sistemi HR/ATS è un vantaggio. Competenze linguistiche
- Ottimo comando dell'inglese (parlato e scritto).
- Buono comando dell'italiano o francese è considerato un forte plus, a seconda della sede. Competenze tecniche e analitiche
- Interesse a lavorare con strumenti e piattaforme HR (es. Applicant Tracking Systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, siti di carriera).
- Buone competenze in MS Office, specialmente in Excel e PowerPoint, con interesse per il reporting e le basi dell'analisi.
- Alta attenzione ai dettagli e accuratezza nel gestire i dati e i compiti amministrativi. Competenze personali
- Forte interesse per Talent Acquisition, il settore bancario e la gestione degli investimenti.
- Eccellenti competenze di comunicazione e interpersonali, con un naturale focus sul servizio e l'esperienza del candidato.
- Organizzato, strutturato e in grado di gestire più compiti e priorità.
- Proattivo, curioso e disposto a prendere responsabilità dei compiti e suggerire miglioramenti.
- Orientato al team, collaborativo e a proprio agio in un ambiente internazionale e multicultural.
- Allineamento con la cultura imprenditoriale di EFG: hands-on, orientato alle soluzioni e aperto al learning.

## I nostri valori
- Responsabilità: Prendersi la responsabilità per i compiti e le sfide, cercando miglioramenti continui
- Hands-on: Essere proattivi per consegnare rapidamente risultati di alta qualità
- Passionate: Essere impegnati e strenuamente per eccellenza
- Orientati alla soluzione: Focus sui risultati per i clienti e trattamento equo dei clienti con una mentalità consapevole del rischio
- Orientati alla partnership: Promuovere collaborazione e teamwork. Lavorare insieme con uno spirito imprenditoriale.

Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'amélioration de l'expérience des candidats, le soutien aux activités quotidiennes de l'Acquisition de Talents et la contribution à la rédaction de rapports et à l'optimisation des processus. Vous aurez également l'opportunité de soutenir et, progressivement, de gérer certaines missions de recrutement junior sous la supervision d'un Spécialiste en Acquisition de Talents.

## Responsabilités principales Expérience des candidats & Soutien TA
- Agir comme point de contact pour les candidats, en assurant une communication claire, ponctuelle et professionnelle tout au long du processus de recrutement.
- Coordonner et planifier les entretiens avec les responsables du recrutement et autres parties prenantes.
- Soutenir les Spécialistes en Acquisition de Talents dans le dépistage des CV et l'évaluation des candidats par rapport aux exigences du poste.
- Rédiger et publier les offres d'emploi sur les plateformes internes et externes, en veillant à la cohérence avec la marque employeur d'EFG. Soutien opérationnel et administratif
- Exécuter les opérations quotidiennes dans le système de suivi des candidats (ATS), y compris la saisie de données, les vérifications de qualité des données et les mises à jour de statut.
- Maintenir des dossiers de candidats précis et assurer une documentation appropriée de chaque étape du processus de recrutement.
- Préparer des correspondances standard et des communications avec les candidats et les responsables du recrutement.
- Soutenir la coordination des évaluations (tests, études de cas, vérifications de références), le cas échéant. Reporting & Amélioration des processus
- Soutenir la préparation de rapports de recrutement réguliers et de tableaux de bord simples (par exemple, statut du pipeline, temps d'embauche, sources d'embauche).
- Aider à surveiller les indicateurs clés de TA et à identifier des tendances ou des goulots d'étranglement de base dans le processus.
- Contribuer avec des idées pour optimiser et standardiser les processus de recrutement, les modèles et les flux de communication.
- Participer à de petits projets visant à améliorer les outils, l'expérience des candidats et l'efficacité interne de TA. Sourcing & Soutien Employer Branding
- Aider à la recherche de candidats via LinkedIn Recruiter, les plateformes d'emploi, les recommandations et autres canaux.
- Effectuer des premiers présélections téléphoniques ou vidéo pour les postes sélectionnés, sous supervision.
- Soutenir les initiatives de branding employeur (par exemple, préparation de contenus pour les réseaux sociaux ou le site de carrière, ou les salons de l'emploi). Exposition au recrutement junior
- Soutenir progressivement et, le cas échéant, gérer le recrutement end-to-end pour des postes junior ou de stage, sous la supervision d'un Spécialiste en Acquisition de Talents.

## Compétences et expérience Éducation & Expérience
- Diplôme de master (ou actuellement inscrit dans un programme de master) en Ressources Humaines, Administration des Affaires, Psychologie ou un domaine connexe.
- Expérience antérieure (stage, emploi à temps partiel ou similaire) en recrutement, RH ou branding employeur est un plus.
- Expérience en gestion de données, reporting ou travail avec des systèmes HR/ATS est un avantage. Compétences linguistiques
- Excellent niveau d'anglais (oral et écrit).
- Bon niveau de français ou d'italien est considéré comme un fort atout, selon le lieu de travail. Compétences techniques et analytiques
- Intérêt pour le travail avec les outils et plateformes RH (par exemple, systèmes de suivi des candidats, LinkedIn Recruiter, sites de carrière).
- Bonnes compétences en MS Office, notamment en Excel et PowerPoint, avec un intérêt pour le reporting et les bases de l'analyse.
- Forte attention aux détails et précision dans la gestion des données et des tâches administratives. Compétences personnelles
- Forte intérêt pour l'Acquisition de Talents, le secteur bancaire et la gestion des investissements.
- Excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, avec un naturel focus sur le service et l'expérience des candidats.
- Organisé, structuré et capable de gérer plusieurs tâches et priorités.
- Proactif, curieux et prêt à prendre en charge les tâches et à suggérer des améliorations.
- Orienté vers l'équipe, collaboratif et à l'aise dans un environnement international et multiculturel.
- Alignement avec la culture entrepreneuriale d'EFG : hands-on, orienté vers les solutions et ouvert à l'apprentissage.

## Nos valeurs
- Responsabilité : Prendre en charge les tâches et les défis, en cherchant une amélioration continue
- Hands-on : Être proactif pour livrer rapidement des résultats de haute qualité
- Passionné : Être engagé et travailler pour l'excellence
- Orienté vers la solution : Se concentrer sur les résultats pour les clients et traiter les clients de manière équitable avec une mentalité consciente des risques
- Orienté vers la partenariat : Promouvoir la collaboration et le travail d'équipe. Travailler ensemble avec un esprit entrepreneurial.

## Job Description

The position of Operational Risk Analyst sits within the Operational Risk function and focuses on strengthening the bank’s risk management and internal control framework globally. Acting as a key risk partner to the first line of defence, the position provides independent challenge and oversight on operational risks, ensuring that processes, systems and activities are managed in line with the bank’s risk appetite.

Location: Lugano, Zurich, Geneva.

Main responsibilities

-  Oversee the effective and consistent implementation and maintenance of the risk and control management framework globally.

-  Contribute to thematic risk and control assessments on a broad range of issues, including back and middle-office, funds, securities, payments, corporate actions, and order execution through collaboration with other stakeholders.

-  Perform process-level walkthroughs and control testing to enable the identification and assessment of risks and controls.

-  Proactively escalate and effectively communicate material control weaknesses, closely collaborate with key stakeholders in the relevant functions to define appropriate action plans and oversee their timely implementation.

-  Provide expertise and make recommendations for improvements to steer adherence to internal regulations, regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
   Skills and experience

-  Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, or a technical field (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics).

-  At least 5 to 7 years of experience in the banking sector (ideally in Risk Control, Audit, or Business Risk Management), or in consulting/audit with a leading professional services firm; a combination of both is considered an advantage.

-  Strong understanding of banking processes and systems, products, and related regulatory requirements. Expertise with core banking systems and Front systems is a plus.

-  Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written. Knowledge of German, French, or Italian is a plus.

-  Proven ability to write reports and communicate effectively with a senior audience.

-  Self-motivated, diligent, highly organized, able to prioritize and multi-task, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

-  Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, able to work autonomously and as part of a global team.

-  Innovative mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.
   Our Values

Accountability : Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

Hands-on : Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

Passionate : Being committed and striving for excellence

Solution-driven : Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

Partnership-oriented : Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

## Job Description

The Technology & Cyber Information Security Risk Analyst will be part of the Operational Risk team. We are looking for a passionate IT risk, cyber and information security to cover a global role located in Switzerland.

Location: Geneva, Zurich, Lugano.

## Main responsibilities

- Oversee the effective and consistent implementation and maintenance of the risk and control management framework globally.

- Contribute to thematic risk and control assessments on IT security issues, cyber risk, and threat analysis through collaboration with other internal stakeholders.

- Perform process-level walkthroughs and control testing to enable the identification and assessment of risks and controls.

- Provide expertise, make recommendations for improvements to steer adherence to internal regulations, regulatory requirements and industry best practices, and monitor their implementation.

- Manages relationships with key stakeholders within the First Line of Defence.

- Stays abreast and advises the Bank on innovative business and technology trends in risks and controls.

Skills and experience

- Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or equivalent.

- Professional certification, e.g. Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Information Security Manager, (CISM), Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Risk and

- Information Systems Control (CRISC) or equivalent.

- At least 3-5 years of experience in banking IT platforms, operational processes and IT controls, or in consulting/audit with a leading professional services firm; a combination of both is considered an advantage.

- Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written. Knowledge of German, French, or Italian is a plus.

- In-depth understanding of key technology and information security concepts relevant to banking. In particular, strong knowledge of IT organisation, business processes and systems (e.g. IT Security, data management, architecture and planning, life cycle management and regulatory matters).

- Proven ability to write reports and communicate effectively with a senior audience.

- Self-motivated, diligent, highly organized, able to prioritize and multi-task, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, able to work autonomously and as part of a global team.

## Our values

- Accountability : Taking ownership for tasks and challenges as well as seeking continuous improvement.

- Hands-on : Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results.

- Passionate : Being committed and striving for excellence.

- Solution-driven : Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset.

- Partnership-oriented : Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

## Job Description

The position of Operational Risk and Advisory Specialist is within the Operational Risk Function, a critical component of the second line of defense. This role is responsible for providing comprehensive oversight of operational risk activities, with a strong emphasis on new technologies, information security, and cyber risks. The Operational Risk function engages in advisory, risk assessment, analysis, and reporting to the Bank’s governing bodies.

## Main Responsibilities

-  Development, Implementation, and Execution of Risk Activities:

- Enhance the risk management framework in relation to risk assessment and advisory, particularly in relation to new technologies, information security and cyber risks.

- Collaborate with business units to integrate advanced risk management practices into their operations.

-  Risk Assessment and Analysis:

- Conduct ad hoc risk assessments and analyses, especially concerning information security and cyber threats, to identify potential issues and propose efficient mitigating measures.

- Perform incident analysis to determine root causes, identify mitigating actions, and ensure follow-up.

-  Advisory Support:

- Provide advisory support to Business Units, including reviewing the Internal Control Framework with a focus IT and Information Security in the way they support the sustainable business development of the Bank

- Offer expert advice on risk mitigation strategies, particularly related to information security and emerging technologies.

-  Reporting and Communication:

- Report and present risk assessment results to the Risk Control leadership group and other relevant stakeholders, with a focus on cyber risk and technological vulnerabilities.

- Prepare detailed risk reports and presentations for executive review.

-  Digital Solutions Deployment:

- Actively participate in deploying new digital solutions to support the implementation of the internal control system globally, ensuring these solutions address information security and cyber risk concerns.

## Skills and Experience

- University degree in business administration, economics, science, information security, or a related field.

- 10 years of working experience, including consulting or audit at a leading professional services firm and/or in a comparable position at a market-leading bank.

- Strong understanding of core banking systems, end-to-end transaction processing, and cybersecurity principles.

- Proven ability to write reports and communicate effectively with a senior audience.

- Excellent analytical skills and a structured approach to problem-solving and reporting.

- Exceptional communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

- Capacity to work autonomously and as part of a global team in a fast-paced environment.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Job Description

Within Risk & Compliance IT, you are responsible for key applications (primarily from sas.com) and play a  hands-on  role on the technical solutions: support of the application, data models, reports, data flows and functional enhancements.

The role is evenly split between hands‑on technical activities (around 50%) and business analysis / project responsibilities (around 50%).

You combine a solid understanding of Risk & Compliance topics with strong technical skills (SQL / SAS / data modelling), while working closely with business stakeholders and external providers.

## Main Responsibilities

- Act as IT Application Owner for Risk & Compliance solutions.

- Analyse business needs and translate them into concrete technical solutions.

- Design, adapt and optimise data models, extractions and reports (SQL, SAS).

- Manage application changes end-to-end: impact analysis, specifications, coordination with provider teams, UAT and go‑live.

- Provide advanced day‑to‑day support to users; investigate and resolve issues, escalating to provider or internal teams when necessary.

- Ensure the quality, integrity and security of data used for risk and compliance reporting.

## Profile

- University degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field.

- Proven experience in a banking or financial services environment, ideally within Risk or Compliance.

- Strong hands‑on skills in SQL and relational databases (writing and optimising queries, designing data models).

- Practical experience with SAS for reporting and/or data processing; knowledge of SAS Asset & Liability Risk Management is a strong plus.

- Comfortable working with Windows Server and Linux environments.

- Experience with IT service management and full software lifecycle.

- Able to work independently, manage requests end‑to‑end and collaborate with distributed teams.

- Excellent communication skills in English; French and or Italian is an asset.

## Our values

-  Accountability : Taking ownership for tasks and challenges as well as seeking continuous improvement.

-  Hands-on : Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results.

-  Passionate : Being committed and striving for excellence.

-  Solution-driven : Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset.

-  Partnership-oriented : Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

Job Description

As part of the Business Management team within the Global Markets & Treasury division, you will gain hands-on exposure to how strategic and operational decisions are supported through data, reporting and analysis. Working closely with senior team members, you will contribute to the production of key management information and help ensure that decision-makers have timely, accurate and insightful material at their disposal.

You will be involved in a broad range of activities, from understanding and mapping processes, managing data and dashboards to preparing presentations for senior stakeholders. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop a solid understanding of Global Markets & Treasury business and associated financial and risk metrics, and experience how a leading financial institution operates on a day-to-day basis.

Main responsibilities
- Understanding, documenting and assisting in improving processes for Global Markets & Treasury.
- Manage and maintain data sources and dashboards, ensuring information is accurate, consistent and up to date.
- Produce regular and ad hoc management reports (financials, risk metrics and KPIs) to support monitoring and decision-making.
- Prepare clear, well-structured presentations for committees, management forums and ad hoc business requests.
- Collaborate with colleagues across functions to gather input, validate data and ensure alignment of information.

Skills and experience
- Graduate student available for six months for internship (required by University) – Depending on the needs of the organisation, the internship may be extended for an additional six month.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills, with a keen attention to detail and data quality.
- Good command of Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. dashboards) is an advantage.
- Ability to structure information clearly and present it in a concise, visually appealing way.
- Strong communication skills and willingness to interact with different stakeholders.
- Proactive, organised and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines. Open minded, curious and eager to learn.
- Very good knowledge of written and spoken English; additional national language is an asset.

Our Values
- Accountability : Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement.
- Hands-on : Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results.
- Passionate : Being committed and striving for excellence.
- Solution-driven : Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset.
- Partnership-oriented : Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit..

Nous servons des clients dans plus de 40 emplacements à travers le monde. EFG International offre un environnement de travail stimulant et dynamique et s'efforce d'être un employeur de choix. Notre objectif et notre mission Donner aux esprits entrepreneuriaux les moyens de créer de la valeur – aujourd'hui et pour l'avenir. Description du poste En tant que membre de l'équipe de gestion d'entreprise au sein de la division Global Markets & Treasury, vous aurez une exposition pratique à la manière dont les décisions stratégiques et opérationnelles sont soutenues par des données, des rapports et des analyses. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des membres seniors de l'équipe, vous contribuerez à la production d'informations clés pour la gestion et aiderez à garantir que les décideurs disposent de matériel opportun, précis et pertinent. Vous serez impliqué dans un large éventail d'activités, allant de la compréhension et de la cartographie des processus, à la gestion des données et des tableaux de bord, en passant par la préparation de présentations pour les parties prenantes seniors. Ce rôle offre une excellente opportunité de développer une compréhension solide des activités de Global Markets & Treasury ainsi que des indicateurs financiers et de risque associés, et de découvrir le fonctionnement quotidien d'une institution financière de premier plan. Principales responsabilités
- Comprendre, documenter et aider à améliorer les processus pour Global Markets & Treasury.
- Gérer et maintenir les sources de données et les tableaux de bord, en veillant à ce que les informations soient exactes, cohérentes et à jour.
- Produire des rapports de gestion réguliers et ad hoc (financiers, indicateurs de risque et KPI) pour soutenir le suivi et la prise de décision.
- Préparer des présentations claires et bien structurées pour les comités, les forums de gestion et les demandes commerciales ad hoc.
- Collaborer avec des collègues de différentes fonctions pour recueillir des contributions, valider les données et garantir l'alignement des informations. Compétences et expérience
- Étudiant diplômé disponible pour un stage de six mois (exigé par l'université) – Selon les besoins de l'organisation, le stage peut être prolongé de six mois supplémentaires.
- Solides compétences en calcul et en analyse, avec une grande attention aux détails et à la qualité des données.
- Bonne maîtrise d'Excel et de PowerPoint ; la familiarité avec les outils de visualisation de données (par exemple, tableaux de bord) est un atout.
- Capacité à structurer clairement les informations et à les présenter de manière concise et visuellement attrayante.
- Excellentes compétences en communication et volonté d'interagir avec différents intervenants.
- Proactif, organisé et capable de gérer plusieurs tâches et échéances. Ouvert d'esprit, curieux et désireux d'apprendre.
- Très bonne maîtrise de l'anglais écrit et parlé ; une langue nationale supplémentaire est un atout. Nos valeurs
- Responsabilité : Assumer la responsabilité des tâches et des défis, tout en cherchant à s'améliorer en permanence.
- Pratique : Être proactif pour livrer rapidement des résultats de haute qualité.
- Passionné : Être engagé et viser l'excellence.
- Orienté solutions : Se concentrer sur les résultats pour les clients et les traiter équitablement avec une approche consciente des risques.
- Orienté partenariat : Promouvoir la collaboration et le travail d'équipe. Travailler ensemble avec un esprit entrepreneurial. Veuillez joindre une lettre de motivation à votre CV lors de votre candidature.

## Job Description

Business partner focused on executive and line management Support, people management, quality execution of HR processes, and support on key HR projects. Also, responsible for managing regional recruiting, employee lifecycle and experience, performance management, retention, and learning and development.

## Tasks and Responsibilities

- Responsible for strategic recruiting, talent attraction and selection process firmwide (sourcing talent, screening, selection, coordinating interviews, being an active member of the interview process, contract management, and the like); adherence to established Group processes, including approval processes and all sub-processes contained within.

- Responsible for managing the entire employee lifecycle/employee journey offering from end-to-end, including onboarding and onboarding experience, training design and follow through, development and retention support, offboarding, internal mobility, benefits, and all related, all the while utilizing available and improved people tools.

- Support performance management processes for the region, including performance reviews, planning and goal setting, reward and recognition, developing and coaching, disciplinary actions, personal improvement plans, L&D, employee engagement initiatives.

- Development and coordination of regional hr program and regional monthly calendar of events, including community outreach program, as well as all cultural enhancement initiatives. Also manage all related budgets.

- Support on implementation of glocal HR Programs, as well as special projects, as assigned.

## Requirements and Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources and/or related subject or equivalent experience. PHR preferred

- 5 - 7 years of previous Human Resources experience

- Previous experience in Banking, Broker Dealer and/or related field

- Excellent assessment and problem solving skills

- Outstanding excel and presentation skills

- Cross functional collaboration

- Must be able to work independently and take initiative

- Detail oriented

## Our Values

-  Accountability:  Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

-  Hands-on:  Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

-  Passionate:  Being committed and striving for excellence

-  Solution-driven:  Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

-  Partnership-oriented:  Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Partner aziendale focalizzato sul supporto esecutivo e di gestione della linea, la gestione delle persone, l'esecuzione della qualità dei processi HR e il supporto ai progetti chiave HR. Inoltre, responsabile della gestione del reclutamento regionale, del ciclo di vita dei dipendenti e dell'esperienza, della gestione delle prestazioni, della ritenzione e dell'apprendimento e dello sviluppo.

## Tasks and Responsibility
- Responsabile per il reclutamento strategico, l'attrazione del talento e il processo di selezione a livello solido (il talento, la proiezione, la selezione, il coordinamento delle interviste, essendo un membro attivo del processo di intervista, la gestione del contratto e simili); aderenza ai processi consolidati del Gruppo, compresi i processi di approvazione e tutti i sotto-processi contenuti all'interno.
- Responsabile per la gestione dell'intero ciclo di vita dei dipendenti/offerta di viaggio dipendente da end-to-end, tra cui l'esperienza di bordo e di bordo, la progettazione di formazione e seguire attraverso, lo sviluppo e il supporto di ritenzione, offboarding, mobilità interna, benefici e tutti i relativi, tutto il tempo utilizzando disponibili e strumenti migliorati della gente.
- Sostenere i processi di gestione delle prestazioni per la regione, tra cui recensioni sulle prestazioni, pianificazione e impostazione degli obiettivi, ricompensa e riconoscimento, sviluppo e coaching, azioni disciplinari, piani di miglioramento personale, L&D, iniziative di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti.
- Sviluppo e coordinamento del programma regionale hr e calendario mensile regionale di eventi, compreso il programma di sensibilizzazione della comunità, così come tutte le iniziative di valorizzazione culturale. Inoltre gestire tutti i budget correlati.
- Supporto per l'implementazione di glocal HR Programs, così come progetti speciali, come assegnato.

## Requisiti e qualifiche
- Laurea in Risorse Umane e/o materie correlate o esperienza equivalente. PHR ha preferito - 5 - 7 anni della precedente esperienza di Risorse Umane
- Esperienza precedente in Banking, Broker Dealer e/o campo correlato
- Valutazione eccellente e capacità di problem solving
- Eccellente eccellenze e capacità di presentazione
- Cross collaborazione funzionale
- Deve essere in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente e prendere iniziativa
- Promuovere orientato al dettaglio

## I nostri valori
- Affidabilità: Prendere la proprietà per compiti e sfide, oltre a cercare un miglioramento continuo
- Hands- Lavorare insieme a uno spirito imprenditoriale.

Description de l'emploi Partenaire d'affaires axé sur la direction et la gestion hiérarchique Soutien, gestion des personnes, exécution de qualité des processus de RH et soutien à des projets clés de RH. De plus, il est chargé de gérer le recrutement régional, le cycle de vie et l'expérience des employés, la gestion du rendement, le maintien en poste et l'apprentissage et le perfectionnement.

## Tâches et responsabilités
- Responsable du recrutement stratégique, de l'attraction des talents et du processus de sélection à l'échelle de l'entreprise (recrutement des talents, présélection, sélection, coordination des entrevues, participation active au processus d'entrevue, gestion des contrats, etc.); respect des processus de groupe établis, y compris les processus d'approbation et tous les sous-processus contenus dans le processus.
- Responsable de la gestion de l'ensemble du cycle de vie des employés/de l'offre de voyage des employés de bout en bout, y compris l'expérience de bord et d'embarquement, la conception et le suivi de la formation, le soutien au développement et au maintien en poste, le hors-bord, la mobilité interne, les avantages et tout ce qui s'y rapporte, tout en utilisant les outils de personnes disponibles et améliorés.
- Appuyer les processus de gestion du rendement dans la région, y compris les examens du rendement, la planification et l'établissement d'objectifs, la récompense et la reconnaissance, l'élaboration et l'encadrement, les mesures disciplinaires, les plans d'amélioration personnelle, les initiatives de L&D et d'engagement des employés.
- Élaboration et coordination d'un programme régional d'hr et d'un calendrier mensuel régional d'événements, y compris un programme de sensibilisation communautaire, ainsi que de toutes les initiatives d'amélioration culturelle. Gérer également tous les budgets connexes.
- Appui à la mise en oeuvre des programmes locaux de ressources humaines, ainsi qu'à des projets spéciaux, selon les affectations.

## Exigences et qualifications
- Baccalauréat Diplôme en ressources humaines et/ou matière connexe ou expérience équivalente. PHR préféré - 5 - 7 ans d'expérience en ressources humaines
- Expérience antérieure en banque, courtier et/ou domaine connexe
- Excellente capacité d'évaluation et de résolution de problèmes
- Excellente capacité d'exceller et de présenter
- Collaboration interfonctionnelle
- Doit être capable de travailler de façon indépendante et de prendre des initiatives
- Détail

## Nos valeurs
- Responsabilité : S'approprier les tâches et les défis, et chercher à s'améliorer continuellement
- Hands-on : Être proactif pour obtenir rapidement des résultats de haute qualité
- Passionné : S'engager et s'efforcer d'atteindre l'excellence
- Inspiré de la solution : Se concentrer sur les résultats des clients et traiter les clients avec équité avec un état d'esprit conscient des risques
- Objectif partenariat : Promouvoir la collaboration et le travail d'équipe. Travailler ensemble avec un esprit d'entreprise.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Job Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive intern to join the internal audit team covering the Private Banking business across Asia. The successful candidate will integrate a high performing team and participate in audits across various processes such as client onboarding, sales and suitability, products and operations, ensuring robust control environments and compliance with regulatory requirements.

## Key Responsibilities

- Assist the team in planning and executing internal audits.

- Perform walkthroughs, test controls, and assess compliance with policies, procedures, and regulatory standards.

- Prepare clear and concise audit documentation, findings, and recommendations for process improvements.

- Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand processes and identify areas of risk.

- Support the follow-up and resolution of audit findings and recommendations.

- Utilize data analytics to identify emerging risks (data analytics skills are a plus).

## Requirements / Skillset

- Candidates to be currently enrolled in a recognized university, with a preference for students in their penultimate or final year of study. Besides finance-related degrees, applicants from diverse backgrounds, including engineering, mathematics, and technology will be considered .

- A broad understanding of the banking industry and investment products would be a plus. Any prior experience in finance, accounting or risk is relevant.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills; proficiency in Excel (Understanding of basic data analytics tools and techniques is an advantage).

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

- Ability to work independently yet to proactively seek guidance from senior auditors.

- Ability to work independently yet to proactively seek guidance from senior auditors.
